scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w admin && npm run build -w seller
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w api && npm run lint -w admin && npm run lint -w seller
scripts.test: npm run test -w api && npm run test -w admin && npm run test -w seller
scripts.admin:provision: npm run build -w api --silent && node apps/api/dist/scripts/provision-admin.js
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w admin && npm run typecheck -w seller
scripts.admin:seed-demo: npm run build -w api --silent && node apps/api/dist/scripts/seed-admin-demo.js
